question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a shipped cross-channel pool for initial acknowledgment reactions, and if so should selection be non-model or context/model-driven?
rationale: The alternatives change a shipped configuration/API contract and have materially different latency, predictability, and channel-portability consequences.

options.title: Close pending sponsorship
options.body: Close now and reopen when a maintainer explicitly sponsors a compatible selector contract.

options.title: Sponsor configured pool
options.body: Approve an optional list with deterministic or random non-model selection and channel-specific fallback behavior.

options.title: Sponsor contextual selection
options.body: Approve a pre-ack model decision hook despite additional latency and runtime complexity.

recommendation.title: Close pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Close now and reopen when a maintainer explicitly sponsors a compatible selector contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their shared-helper history and prior issue review make them the strongest available owner for deciding whether this core behavior should be sponsored.
